criteria.reason: The keyboard row contains Copy Last, Done, and Next buttons.
Done has flex: 2 while the adjacent buttons each have flex: 1, so it is narrower than the former full-width button.
All three buttons have a 48px minimum height.
Copy Last uses the prior set's value for the matching field and sends it to onChange.
Next switches keypad state to reps, but NumericKeypad does not sync its displayed value when that state changes, so focus advancement is incomplete.
The button styles use design system color and radius variables.
The action buttons use a flexible row layout that accommodates the keypad on mobile.
None of the button labels contain exclamation marks or hype.
The harness reports all 197 server and 291 client tests passing.
A new test checks that Copy Last sends the previous value to onChange.
